task_description: Implement GitHub Issue #13 on the deployed MLB postseason repo: (1) localize the AI-generated prediction narrative to the current UI language (EN/JA); (2) make the Bedrock model selectable instead of hardcoded Haiku; (3) offer Amazon-family models (Amazon Nova; Titan has no text-gen model in us-east-1) via a per-provider request/response adapter while keeping Claude available and the deterministic fallback intact; (4) add a data-integrity check that detects finished games/series still referencing an undetermined/TBD/placeholder team and surfaces non-blocking warnings. Thread language+model through api->handler->service->narrative. Update infra IAM confirmation, specs, and README/README.ja.md. Local incremental commits on feat/mlb-postseason-site; no push/PR/deploy.

review.detail: v1 NEEDS_CHANGES (Amazon Nova InvokeModel body omitted required schemaVersion 'messages-v1'; strategy selector catch-all; test did not pin schemaVersion). Fixed in commit 594605e (provider-driven adapter selection + schemaVersion + test contract). v2 APPROVED with 0 remaining issues.

verification.summary: npm run build green across all four workspaces. npm test: 147 passed (shared 22, backend 78, frontend 39, infra 8), including new per-provider Bedrock adapter shaping tests (Anthropic + Amazon Nova via injected client), EN/JA prompt+fallback, resolveModelId allowlist, and the finished-game TBD integrity check (unit + fast-check property). npm run synth succeeds (no AWS calls). npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend: 20 passed, including the model selector, lang=ja passthrough + language toggle re-request, and the integrity banner. Test quality verified: the Nova adapter test asserts the real request body/response shape against an injected client and would fail if reverted to Anthropic-only; the integrity property test exercises the real function with mixed real/placeholder ids across all statuses. No Dockerfile in repo, so docker_build skipped.
